name: dsh-chime-alerts
description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: sound alerts for ten agent events — completion, subagent completion, background-job completion, approval, plugin approval, question, plan-review, goal-blocked, interruption, and background-job failure (browser Web Audio + system beep + Windows toast, per-event off/beep/notify mode with notification level, per-event sounds/volume, per-workspace mute with a read-only sidebar marker)

scripts.test: node tools/build-body.mjs --verify && node tools/chunk-src.mjs --verify && node tools/test-host.mjs && node tools/test-client.mjs && node tools/test-client-web.mjs
scripts.check: node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/host.js && node --check lib/client.web.js && node tools/syntax-check.mjs && node tools/build-body.mjs --verify && node tools/chunk-src.mjs --verify

description.zh: 十类 Agent 事件的声音提醒：任务完成 / 子任务完成 / 后台任务完成 / 需要授权 / 插件授权 / Agent 提问 / 计划评审 / 目标受阻 / 其他打断 / 后台任务失败。每个事件三选一（关 / 响铃 / 通知）：响铃走浏览器 Web Audio + 系统音效，通知是宿主弹的 Windows toast（可设静默 / 普通 / 重要），页面关闭后宿主提醒照常工作；每事件独立音色与音量，按工作区静音（设置页分组 + 侧栏标题旁只读标记）。
description.en: Sound alerts for ten agent events: completion, subagent completion, background-job completion, approval, plugin approval, question, plan-review, goal-blocked, interruption, and background-job failure. Each event is off / beep / notify: beep plays browser Web Audio plus a host system sound, notify raises a Windows toast (silent / normal / important) from the host so it keeps working with the page closed. Per-event sounds and volume, plus per-workspace mute (a settings section and a read-only sidebar marker).
